scope: Read-only SSOT/evidence reconciliation for the generic Agent Package + Runtime + WebUI build path. IBD/OMA is a reference sample only. No registry write, deployment, provider mutation or real-money mutation was performed by this audit.

sampleTcrArtifact.samplePackage: IBD/OMA Agent Package; example input, not an IBD-specific product build path

proven: A sample Agent OCI manifest was read back from the customer-private TCR repository at the stated digest.
The local Cloud owner chain can compose Package + Runtime + WebUI through BuildKit, persist owner events and recover the exact local Registry artifact after worker acknowledgement loss.
notProven: That the customer TCR digest is the output of the recorded local Build job.
That a Tencent/TKE-hosted Cloud Build job selected the Tenant's email-local-part repository and pushed this digest there.
Automatic Tenant repository reservation/provisioning or multi-Tenant repository isolation on TCR.

correctedClaim: The sample TCR publication and local Build owner-chain verification are two successful but separately evidenced facts. Their same-job provenance link is not established.
instanceBoundary: Instance deploys one-person-lab-cloud and injects installation-level configuration. Cloud Build owns Agent OCI publication; Cloud Serve/Fabric owns any Agent deployment to a Workspace/TKE runtime.
